description: This is a shell script that monitors the /var/log/messages log file for specific trigger patterns related to the 'Utopia' system, specifically for new host monitoring in a firewall context. It sets up, manages, and terminates monitoring processes and interacts with system events and log rotation signals.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Initializes monitoring by killing older instances, cleaning up old files, creating log links, and starting log tailing with awk processing.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Terminates the monitoring by killing the trigger process and updating the status.
